starter_ships.style: classical NPC-near ships; bright natural materials; mobile-readable

design_rules: Classes use multiple ship generations and hull families, not one recolor chain.
Silhouette variety requires different hulls, proportions, bow/stern forms, deck structures, mast/sail layouts, weapon arrangements, materials, ornaments and special features.
Color and theme support identity but never replace form variation.
Early classes remain grounded; extreme Abyss, monster and mystical forms escalate mainly toward later classes.
Size, sail count and strength are not automatically coupled.
Class and design are separate; Event, PvP, Admiral, Boss, Season, Payment, Guild and Achievement designs remain independent pools.
Every silhouette must remain readable from the oblique top-down mobile sea-map camera.
production_rule: Reserved class does not require a placeholder GLB until its scheduled production wave; mass duplication is not silhouette coverage.
